# Atrium

> Atrium is a calm, single-window desktop cockpit (Tauri + React + xterm.js, built for Windows + WSL2
> and macOS) for your coding agents, terminals, and dev servers — organized into projects with live
> status. It is an organizer, not an orchestrator: it never drives or dispatches agents (visibility-in,
> never control-out). Current version 0.15.1; it ships a local MCP server (since 0.8.0) so agents can
> see the cockpit and write into it.

## For agents (MCP)

Atrium exposes a local stdio MCP server (the agent spawns `atrium --mcp-stdio`, reaching state over the
shared filesystem). Tools are read + write-into-Atrium ONLY — there is no spawn/run/control verb.

- Read: list_projects, list_panes, pane_status(pane_id), read_pane_output(pane_id) [read a sibling
  pane's recent logs], list_todos, read_scratchpad(slug)
- Write-into-Atrium: add_todo(text), set_todo_status(id, status), append_scratchpad(slug, text)

Full guide (for both humans and LLMs): https://redlinelabs-dev.github.io/atrium-site/guides/agents-mcp/
